title: Challenger Carbon Matte Black

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: The LS2 Challenger Carbon Matte Black is engineered for everyday agility, rapid ventilation, and effortless usability, pairing agile street ergonomics with certified multi-impact protection. Built around a Aerospace-Grade 100% Carbon Fiber shell weighing a featherweight 1318g, its multi-density EPS matrix is aerodynamically sculpted to isolate cabin noise to ~87 dB while dissipating kinetic impact forces across DOT, ECE 22.06 benchmarks. Inside, 3D laser-cut cheek pads tailor naturally to an Intermediate Oval profile with dedicated eyewear relief channels, secured by track-proven Double D-Ring retention for confident all-day riding.

product_details.description: Carbon shell sport with HPFC multi-axial direction impact protection.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Designed for oval to intermediate head shapes; features a narrow chin bar and extended cheek coverage.

technical_analysis: Features Kinetic Polymer Alloy (KPA) / HPFC High Performance Fiberglass Composite shell construction paired with 3D Optically Correct Class A polycarbonate visor with quick release system and internal sun shield. The interior utilizes Laser-cut multi-density EPS with breathable hypoallergenic removable lining with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.
marketing_description: Experience the LS2 Challenger Carbon Matte Black: combining Spain / China 🇪🇸🇨🇳 craftsmanship with 3D Optically Correct Class A polycarbonate visor with quick release system and internal sun shield and Laser-cut multi-density EPS with breathable hypoallergenic removable lining. Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.
yoast_title: LS2 Challenger Carbon Matte Black: Specs, Real-World Review & Price Guide
yoast_metadesc: In-depth review of the LS2 Challenger Carbon Matte Black. Tested shell weight, ECE/DOT safety rating, noise dB quietness, and fitment guide for Intermediate Oval heads.

introduction: Positioned in LS2's Full Face lineup, the Challenger Carbon Matte Black brings Spanish engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified DOT, ECE 22.06 track safety.
story:
The LS2 Challenger Carbon Matte Black represents LS2's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its Aerospace-Grade 100% Carbon Fiber shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~87 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking an Aerospace-Grade 100% Carbon Fiber Full Face helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the LS2 Challenger Carbon Matte Black delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
